calculation_handling.description: Transition: Articles 200.15.1, 200.15.5 and 200.15.10 do not prevent a project with a complete site plan application filed on or before the cut-off date if it complies with 200.15.15.4 and 200.15.15.5.
Site plan approval stage: approval may be granted if the project complies with 200.15.15.4, 200.15.15.5 and the Planning Act and City of Toronto Act.
A building permit may be issued if the project complies, or is amended to comply, with 200.15.15.4, 200.15.15.5, the site plan approval and finally approved minor variances.
Defines a complete application for site plan approval as one meeting Official Plan Policy 5.5.2.

200.15.15.3(1).explanation: Transition rule: Articles 200.15.1, 200.15.5 and 200.15.10 do not stop a project with a complete site plan approval application filed on or before May 26, 2017, if it complies with 200.15.15.4, 200.15.15.5 and finally approved minor variances.

200.15.15.3(2).explanation: For a qualifying site plan project, approval may be granted if it complies with 200.15.15.4, 200.15.15.5, the Planning Act and the City of Toronto Act; a building permit may then be issued if it complies, or is amended to comply, with those rules, the site plan approval and approved minor variances.

200.15.15.3(3).explanation: A complete application for site plan approval means one that meets the requirements of City of Toronto Official Plan Policy 5.5.2.
